schema.real: measure() output on the brain of record: detail (nested) and flat (key -> scalar)
schema.nullA: per flat key: real, null values, mean, sd, z, p_two_sided (empirical), beyond_all
schema.nullB: the same against the side-class shuffle (sensitivity)
schema.verdict: pre-registered rule (G1b-structure.md s.0) on the primary statistic
schema.flat keys: SI|kind|hop|pop, SEL|kind|hop|contrast|mean|<eye>_eye, SSI|kind|hop|patch|pop, PC1|kind|hop, PC2|kind|hop1|mean, J|hop|pop|side, wJ|..., Jglobal|hop, reach|measure|pop|side, direct|ipsi|pop

m_system.source: Dunn et al. 2016 via brain.MAUTHNER_PREDICTION (ipsilateral to the stimulus = contralateral to the lobe)

turning.source: Huang et al. 2013: RoV3/MiV1/MiV2 fire for turns to their own side; prey on the right drives the left lobe and turns right

strike.source: conflict: Thiele 2014 + strike toward prey -> -1; Gahtan 2005 anatomy (ipsilateral tectal dendrites) and task R's direct contacts -> +1

nIII_dorsal.source: convergence needs both medial recti; no side prediction

nullB_sensitivity.note: beyond_all in nullB rows assumes a null centred at 0 and does not apply; use z and p

power.formula: largest |z| an index in [-1, 1] can reach = |(+-1 - null mean) / null sd|

tectal_output.note: x in 8 nm voxels, anterior -> posterior; the Mauthner somas sit at x ~70,400
